description: Creates a managed agent session, optionally submits initial input, and returns the session or streams its events when stream is true. See [running sessions](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents-api/sessions).

201.description: The created session or its event stream.

401.description: Authentication or project context was missing.

403.description: The API key lacks the required permission.

404.description: The requested session or event was not found.

409.description: The request conflicted with the current session state.

429.description: The Files API rate limit for your user has been exceeded.

CreateAgentSessionParams.description: Parameters for creating a Managed Agents session.

agent.description: Agent configuration. With `agent_id`, supplied fields override the saved agent for this session. Without `agent_id`, `model` is required.

agent_id.description: The ID of a saved reusable agent. Omit `agent` to use its configuration unchanged.

environment.description: An inline execution environment or a reference to an environment template.

input.description: Initial input to submit when the session is created. A string is shorthand for a single user message. Required when `environment.type` is `none`, or when `stream` is `true` for an environment that is not `self_hosted`; optional for self-hosted and non-streaming execution environments.

metadata.description: Up to 16 string key-value pairs, with keys up to 64 and values up to 512 characters. Omission or null defaults to an empty map.

review.description: Action review mode. Omit to use none.

stream.description: Whether to stream session events as server-sent events. Defaults to `false`.

vault_ids.description: The IDs of vaults made available to the session.

agent.description: The agent running in the session.

created_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the session was created.

environment.description: The execution environment for the session.

error.description: The error that caused the session to fail, if any.

id.description: The ID of the session.

last_active_at.description: The Unix timestamp, in seconds, when the session was last active.

metadata.description: Custom string key-value pairs attached to the session.

required_actions.description: Actions that must be completed before the session can continue.

review.description: Review applied to eligible actions in this session. Omitted when review is none and automatic review is not enabled. Omission means none.

status.description: The current status of the session.

usage.description: Best-effort token usage for the session, or null if unknown. Recorded usage may change.

vault_ids.description: The IDs of vaults made available to the session.

SessionEvent.description: An event emitted by a Managed Agents session.

error.description: The error returned by the API.

SessionAgentConfigParam.description: Agent configuration for a session. Omitted fields inherit from `agent_id` when supplied. Supplied objects and arrays replace the whole field, except experimental settings, which merge by key. Null resets nullable fields.

compaction.description: Context compaction settings. Omit to keep the current settings. A supplied object replaces the settings; null or an empty object enables background compaction.

experimental.description: Experimental settings to merge by key. Omitted settings keep their current values.

instructions.description: Additional instructions appended to the agent's default base instructions. Omit to leave unchanged.

model.description: The model to use for the agent. The requested model name is preserved.

multi_agent.description: Configuration for creating and coordinating subagents.

reasoning.description: Configuration for model reasoning. Omit to keep the current settings; pass `null` to reset to the model's default effort.

service_tier.description: The service tier used for model requests.

text.description: Configuration for text generated by the agent.

tools.description: Tools available to the agent. Omit to inherit, or pass null to clear them. The resolved tool list must fit within 3 MiB (3,145,728 bytes) of compact UTF-8 JSON.

EnvironmentParam.description: The execution environment and optional reusable template for a session.

SessionReviewParam.description: Review applied to eligible actions in a session.
